resources.string: Auto follows the saved CarPlay day/night setting; while CarPlay is open, it follows the live result. Light and Dark stay fixed and do not require a reconnect.
Uses the head unit’s local time. Set different start and end times; overnight ranges are supported.
Start and end times must differ.
Save and return to CarPlay to apply.
Uses the threshold and delay below. Without a light sensor, it follows Android.
When appearance is set to Automatic in CarPlay settings, CarPlay also considers the iPhone time. Even if you select Always day, CarPlay may still appear dark at night.
